summary: Emit 'undefined' for typeof applied to a statically proven unresolvable identifier.

target.notes: ECMAScript typeof uniquely avoids ReferenceError for an unresolvable reference. This optimization requires scope analysis; it does not apply to a TDZ binding.

caveats: If the name resolves to a lexical binding that is still uninitialized, typeof throws ReferenceError instead.

tests.name: edge TDZ differs
tests.input: try { console.log(typeof x); let x = 1; } catch (e) { console.log(e.name); }
tests.expected_behavior: prints ReferenceError; this rule must not match
